scenario_review.observed: The turn naturally ended after 117.874 seconds, named http://127.0.0.1:9/v1, and gave repair guidance. The gate limit is 150 seconds.

scenario_review.scenario: s2 approval during typing, paste, burst, and at 40x14
scenario_review.observed: Stray typing, bracketed paste, unbracketed burst, and a y at 40x14 left the approval unresolved and the file absent. A deliberate arrow-and-Enter action selected denial; the file remained absent.
After the file change, the installed UI displayed “Done · not verified” and explained that no test command was found. This is the UI rendering for the UNVERIFIED outcome.

Esc and Ctrl-C cancellation states appeared in the first TUI redraw after the key event (7.56 ms, 8.89 ms, and 19.39 ms); all are within the exact RC14 100 ms UI frame. Each case returned to idle in under 0.36 seconds. The queued-steer case returned the unapplied message to the composer. A separate running-tool scenario showed the steering text in the next gateway request and displayed it as applied.
The resumed screen showed the prior session identifier, earlier conversation, and resume disposition.

scenario_review.scenario: s8 cancel during a running tool
scenario_review.observed: A real synthetic sleep command was observed in its shell process group before Esc. At the post-cancel snapshot, the shell and sleep PIDs were gone; the TUI, sidecar, and RPC engine remained, as expected for Esc. The interface returned to idle within 2.751 seconds.

scenario_review.scenario: s9 quit during a running tool
scenario_review.observed: The installed TUI exited while a synthetic command ran; the pre-exit command process group and UI process tree had no surviving PIDs afterward. The separate direct RPC probe also confirmed both cancellation responses and no remaining command process.

scenario_review.scenario: r1a lone Enter at REPL approval
scenario_review.observed: The corrected installed-asset probe reached the approval prompt; lone Enter was rejected by the gateway, no file was created, and the isolated HOME was used.

scenario_review.scenario: r1d typed-ahead y at REPL approval
scenario_review.observed: The typed-ahead y was discarded, the approval prompt was reached, the gateway rejected the action, and no file was created.
